usage: frigg ga4 <verb> [flags]

Read-only Google Analytics 4 operator CLI over the tyr/ga4 cap surface.

Commands:
  get-account    Get one GA4 account by id (--account accounts/<id>)
  list-accounts  List every GA4 account the service account can read

Exit: 0 ok, 2 usage, 3 config/creds, 8 disabled (kill switch), 1 other.
